# gxx

> A small coding agent for the terminal.

gxx is a Go CLI that runs inside one directory. Open a repo, type what you want — it lists, searches, reads, patches, and runs commands in that folder only.

## Documentation

- [Install](/gxx/install.md): Install on macOS, Linux, and Windows
- [Quick start](/gxx/quick-start.md): Connect OpenAI or Claude and run your first session
- [REPL](/gxx/repl.md): Keyboard shortcuts, session modes, and slash commands
- [Permissions](/gxx/permissions.md): File writes and shell commands in agent mode
- [Privacy](/gxx/privacy.md): Secrets, storage, and provider requests
- [CLI](/gxx/cli.md): One-shot commands, flags, and piping

## Source
